end_of_life_limits._note: SIH26054 does not define end-of-life. Every limit below is chosen by this project, from the engine's own published/derived operating envelope, and is stated in physical units so it can be argued with, replaced by an operator's own maintenance manual figures, or rejected outright. Health-index percentages are DERIVED from these limits, never the other way round.

oil_system.criterion: Oil pressure at or below limit while at rated RPM
oil_system.operator_text: oil pressure projected to reach {limit} bar
oil_system.source: Rotax 914 UL Operators Manual quotes 1.5 bar minimum oil pressure above 3500 rpm; nominal 3.8 bar is nominal_operating_parameters.oil_pressure_nominal_bar here.

cylinders.criterion: CHT above max continuous, or EGT spread across cylinders beyond margin
cylinders.operator_text: cylinder head temperature projected to reach {limit} C
cylinders.source: Rotax 914 UL Operators Manual quotes 135 C maximum cylinder head temperature (liquid-cooled heads, hottest cylinder). Note nominal_operating_parameters.cht_nominal_celsius in this file is 135 C, which is that MAXIMUM rather than a cruise value; 108 C is taken as typical cruise CHT so the criterion measures a real margin. This is a head-temperature limit on a different cooling architecture from the VRDE engine, not the same number rescaled.

turbo_boost.criterion: Manifold pressure deficit below the rated-boost schedule
turbo_boost.operator_text: manifold pressure projected to fall {limit} bar below rated boost
turbo_boost.source: Derived from altitude_power_derating in this file. The Rotax runs far lower absolute boost (1.35 bar max against 2.45), so the deficit that costs a full derating band is correspondingly smaller.

vibration.operator_text: 2X order vibration projected to reach {limit} g
vibration.source: Scaled from this project's VRDE figure by the ratio of nominal vibration levels (1.1 g against 1.2 g rms). A flat-four has a different order signature from an inline four; treat this as a placeholder pending a real vibration survey.

electrical.criterion: Bus voltage below limit under full avionics load
electrical.operator_text: bus voltage projected to fall to {limit} V
electrical.source: Rotax 914 runs a 14 VDC bus, not 28 VDC. 12.0 V is the same fractional margin this project applies to the VRDE bus, above the ~11 V at which typical 14 V avionics drop out.
